title: AI Workflow Automation
subtitle: Prove ROI and survive enterprise procurement before custom delivery consumes the company.
description: Start with $500 and a credible technical demo. Discover a costly workflow, map a real buying committee, survive security and procurement, negotiate an executable agreement, deliver acceptance, and build repeatable revenue while inference cost, competitors, workforce risk, collections, credit pressure, and custom integration obligations compound.
learningObjectives: Separate demo appeal from paid evidence
Map authority across a buying committee
Negotiate obligations the team can deliver
Protect founder capacity from a service trap

problems.title: The ICP is still a collection of guesses
problems.summary: Demo interest is not evidence of a frequent, expensive workflow problem.
hypotheses: Operations agencies lose paid hours to manual handoffs
Regulated SMBs will pay for auditability
The demand is curiosity rather than urgency

problems.title: There is no credible path to the economic buyer
problems.summary: Users like the demo, but budget, security, procurement, implementation, and signature authorities remain unmapped.
hypotheses: A practitioner can become a champion

problems.title: Personal runway can end before company cash
problems.summary: An income bridge must fund learning without creating unbounded custom work.
hypotheses: A paid diagnostic can fund discovery
Living costs can be reduced safely
Part-time work is the least harmful bridge

problems.title: The platform scope exceeds the evidence
problems.summary: Integration ambition is creating rework before a narrow outcome is validated.
hypotheses: One integration is the real product
The core value is the decision rather than automation

problems.title: The first agreement can create obligations the startup cannot carry
problems.summary: Security, service level, liability, acceptance, and payment terms can turn an apparent win into a liquidity and delivery crisis.
hypotheses: A narrower paid pilot preserves option value
The target account is structurally too demanding
